shared.identity: independent audio seed; never consume visual or gameplay RNG
shared.mix: bounded gain, spectral harshness, duration, repetition and concurrent voices
shared.v1: intentionally crude, humorous and coherent; never unpleasant or clipping
shared.v2: richer coordinated layers and usually transformed bases; same output limits
shared.dsp: reuse licensed native/WASM DSP libraries; no unfinished synthesis represented as complete
shared.license: retain source-specific attribution and derivative license; never relabel all outputs CC0
shared.composition: One pitch register. Radio overrides robot coloration; robot overrides ghost coloration. Mermaid watery layer may coexist. Reverb tails count toward the same voice budget.

death.humanoid: Higher normalized Wilhelm weight, especially transformed variants matching voice policy
death.repetition: Cooldown by source asset, shared across transformed variants; normalize combined trait weights

ANIME_GIRL.style: restrained playful chipmunk register, no shrill octave squeals

bases: unrelated harmless words such as hummus
HITLER.style: absurd monster distortion, not voice imitation

MERMAID.style: watery garble, gentle pitch wobble, filtered vowels and bubbling echo
MERMAID.register: restrained chipmunk; apply once even if CHIBI or ANIME_GIRL

bases: verified actual-animal recordings matching affinity or acoustic family
animals.fallback: clearly labeled synthesized/human imitation, not passed off as actual animal

fire_attack.note: Only suitable auditioned crops; source recordings do not prove usable ignition transients

CHIBI.register: restrained chipmunk shared with mermaid/anime; never stack pitch shifts

ROBOT.style: metallic flanger and short reverb; bounded 80s character

ghost.style: airy modulation and longer bounded reverb; no feedback buildup

HUMANOID.selection: greater probability of licensed word-pronunciation clips, not compulsory speech

bases: licensed pronunciation recordings of Star Wars names such as Anakin, Boba Fett, Darth Maul
STORMTROOPER.style: band-limited radio/walkie-talkie, soft distortion and subtle bounded static

candidates.role: human pronunciation gag, not tiger vocalization

candidates.license: pending exact source resolution; do not silently substitute De-T._rex.ogg

candidates.artist: Work With Sounds / Werstas, Kimmo Kestinen
